config.reutilities.render_outfits.toolti:
Whether to render outfits on your player model and first-person hand.
Disabling this makes the rendering fall back to vanilla.
config.reutilities.render_outfit_on_hand: Whether to render outfits in the "chest" slot in your first-person hand.
Whether to render chestplates in your first-person hand.
config.reutilities.color_emissive_outfit: Whether emissive parts of outfits should be colored.
config.reutilities.light_emitting_emissi: Whether light-emitting blocks should be emissive based on their light level.
config.reutilities.show_components_with_: Whether to display an item's data components when holding Alt.
config.reutilities.line_breaks_on_compon:
Whether component display on tooltips should have line breaks.
§eShort tags may display the newline character. This is an issue with Minecraft's tooltip rendering.§r
config.reutilities.panoramic_screenshots:
Whether panoramic screenshots can be taken using Ctrl + [Screenshot Key].
§cPanoramic screenshots cannot be taken if Iris Shaders is loaded, as the mod breaks the panoramic camera mode added by the vanilla game.
config.reutilities.panoramic_screenshot_:
How big the each screenshot should be. Defaults to 1024px.

Increasing the resolution will lead to images with better quality, but at the cost of performance and storage space.
Which folder panoramic screenshots should be saved to. Defaults to "panorama".
config.reutilities.maximum_bust_size.too:
How big the breasts added by Female Gender Mod can be. Defaults to 0.8.
§eValues above 1 can cause:
∙ An increasing gap between the underboob and the player's chest;
∙ The upper part of the breasts to detach from the player's body.

commands.mstudios.help.title: Help
commands.mstudios.help.description:
Opens a help screen that shows information about a Melony Studios (§7/mstudios§r) command, like this one.

The §lheader§r of this list has basic information about the command, and how it's written, and the §ltext body§r describes how and what the command does.
commands.mstudios.develop.dump_boat_type:
Creates a text file at '.minecraft/dumps/reutilities/boat_types.txt' that contains the identifiers of all registered boat types, being taken from the map located in the class ReCommonConstants.

Enabling §lalphabetical sort§r will sort all identifiers alphabetically.
Creates a text file at '.minecraft/dumps/reutilities/recolors.txt' that contains the identifiers of all registered recolors (new colors added by §oReutilities§r), being taken from the map located in the class ReCommonConstants.

Enabling §lalphabetical sort§r will sort all identifiers alphabetically.
commands.mstudios.develop.sample_color_p: §7/mstudios develop/sample_color_picker §b<color picker> §e[<use the picker's random sequence>]§r

Samples the given color picker and provides the color as hexadecimal, as decimal and as a list of floats.

By §lusing the color picker's random§r
§lsequence§r, this will guarantee that the sampled colors are always in the same order when using the same world seed, but will mess with the order of the samples when the picker is used for purposes outside of this command.
